runtime: Scala standard library (JDK callees use the java table); functions and by-name parameters are typed
conventions: Symbols are package-qualified (scala.Predef.println). Function types A => B, context functions ?=>, by-name parameters => A and SAM types are function types; Any/AnyRef are top types.

entries.why: the parameter is typed Any; toString is dispatched on the argument's class

entries.describe: Future { body } runs the by-name body later on the implicit ExecutionContext
entries.why: the by-name type says the body may run, not that it runs later on another thread

entries.describe: Using.resource(r)(f) runs f and then releases r through the implicit Releasable (close())
entries.why: the release goes through an implicitly selected type class instance

ffi_conventions.describe: JNI: a @native method of class p.C is implemented by the C symbol Java_p_C_name

test_conventions.describe: MUnit suites (classes extending munit.FunSuite) in the sbt test source set; test("name") bodies are run by the runner
ScalaTest suites in the sbt test source set; test/it/should bodies are run by the runner
